source_text: A 2020 systematic review encompassing 20 studies, including high-risk and community-based cohorts, reported pooled incidence ratios for HIV acquisition ranging from 0.29 (95% CI 0.19–0.43) in high-risk groups to 0.56 (95% CI 0.49–0.64) in community cohorts during circumcision scale-up, corresponding to relative risk reductions of 44–71%. [7]
